known_gaps: National Pokédex numbers remain nullable: the supplied PTU Pokédex source is not organized as a directly authoritative National Dex-number field for every extracted record.
Console-game flavor Pokédex entries are not contained in the supplied PTU PDFs and are intentionally not fabricated in this offline seed.
Rotom Appliance Forms are split into partial disabled form records because the source states their Move Lists change but the provided form summary does not enumerate the replacement Move Lists.
Some homebrew/rebalance Features and fallback records remain marked needs_review where PDF layout or non-standard formatting prevents safe full normalization.
reference_unresolved.json is a review queue; fuzzy suggestions are never silently applied.

known_intentional_gaps: National Dex numbers for supplied species #1-890 remain null unless a safe external mapping was available; they are not guessed.
Console-game Pokédex flavor text is not reproduced because it is not present in the supplied PTU PDFs. The schema/import target is ready for a user-provided flavor pack.
Externally cataloged official species without supplied PTU mechanics are browseable/editor-ready stubs and disabled for character creation.
PTU evolution graph edges are emitted only where stage topology is unambiguous; complex branching families are sent to review.
